site_name: 27 Grove Park Road, Tottenham, London, N15 4SW
description:
The existing windows are in poor condition and no longer meet residents’ needs, causing heat loss, condensation, security issues, and other related defects. The client plans to replace all windows to the property.

The timber windows on the front elevation will be replaced with new slimline double-glazed timber windows to match the existing style. The rear elevation windows will be replaced with new double-glazed uPVC casement windows. These works will improve thermal performance, security, and resident comfort within the property.

The main entrance door is also in poor condition and no longer meets residents’ needs, causing heat loss, condensation, and other related defects. The client plans to replace the existing single-glazed timber door with a new double-glazed timber door, improving thermal performance, security, and comfort within the property.
